gui.create_controlling.element.label: Label
A Control Console starts out as a blank, sloped face
Sneak-click it with an empty hand to open the Console Designer
Mount parts anywhere on the face; each one costs a few materials
Buttons, switches, knobs and sliders send redstone signals
Lamps, gauges and nixie tubes show the signals they receive
Click with a Wrench to change the slope
Right-click with a Create casing to re-dress the console
create_controlling.ponder.control_panel_: Every part on a console has its own Redstone Link frequency
Give a switch the same frequency as a Redstone Link…
…and flipping it powers that link from anywhere in range
A button sends a short pulse instead
Knobs and sliders send any strength from 0 to 15
Click to step up, Sneak-click to step down, or hold and drag
Lamps and gauges listen on their frequency instead
Any transmitter on it lights them up, even another console
Showing Display Link text on a Console
Nixie Strips and Display Boards are readouts for text
Point a Display Link at the console, just like at a Display Board
The readouts follow whatever the link reads
Each readout picks its line in the Console Designer; two can share one
